policy: Retain recognizable original world palettes; borrow material morphology and modestly tune response before source variants/transitions. No natural-ground emissive additions.

moon.intent: Retain the separately authored Poly Haven regolith/crater candidate

mars.intent: Keep rusty orange dust, varied weathered rock and restrained dry highlights

venus.intent: Retain ochre/sulphur identity with subdued crust and matte sediment

io.intent: Retain red/yellow volcanic palette; distinguish cooled crust, hot pools and local pale frost

europa.intent: Keep cold blues/white while softening saturated glacier facets and snowy grit

titan.intent: Keep amber/brown identity, with smaller worn icy cobbles and fine sediment instead of only folded rock

ganymede.intent: Keep warm brown/cream identity while introducing dirty fractured ice instead of pebble beds

achilles.intent: Keep lush greens, distinguish soft forest floor from hard wet rock, preserve canopy identity

elysium.intent: Keep gray desolation with softer fine deposits and sharper exposed rock
